title: Project-ADR supersession scaffolder
description: Scaffolds a project-level ADR under rcf/adrs/adr-NNN-<kebab-topic>.json that supersedes every applied blueprint's scope:global ADR on the topic, and appends a matching manifest.resolutions[] record so the conflict detector honours the resolution on subsequent adds. Topic is treated as a LOOKUP KEY, not a slug: any string that exact-matches an applied ADR's declared topic is accepted (schema minLength:1, whitespace-only refused at the writer edge; camelCase, snake_case and kebab-case all pass). The scaffolded ADR id derives its slug tail by kebab-ifying the topic (`authModel` -> `ADR-NNN-auth-model`) so the ADR grammar's `[a-z0-9](-[a-z0-9]+)*` tail is satisfied. Refuses when the manifest is missing prd or tad, when fewer than two applied blueprints carry a scope:global ADR on the topic, and when a file already exists at the scaffolded ADR path.
